permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends your voice and messages to your own Hermes Agent gateway (through the Hermes G2 proxy you run) and to the speech-to-text provider you configure. Nothing is sent to the app developer.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Captures your voice from the glasses microphones while you hold a tap-to-talk turn.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional: capture your voice from the phone microphone instead of the glasses.
